library(tidyverse)

# Creating SMOTE

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_cleaned.Rdata")
dat_cleaned[,c("goal_distance", "shot_angle_degree")] <- scale(dat_cleaned[,c("goal_distance", "shot_angle_degree")])
write.csv(dat_cleaned, file="../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_cleaned_scaled.csv", row.names = F)
rm(dat_cleaned)

load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test.Rdata")
dat_test[,c("goal_distance", "shot_angle_degree")] <- scale(dat_test[,c("goal_distance", "shot_angle_degree")])
save(dat_test, file="../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test_scaled.Rdata")
rm(dat_test)
```

# Fixing SMOTE

```{r}
library(data.table)
f <- dir("../Dataset_ausiliari") 
csv_files <- f[f%like% "dat_smoothed_scaled" & f%like% "csv"]

for (i in 1:length(csv_files)){
  dat_smoothed <- read.csv( paste0("../Dataset_ausiliari/", csv_files[i]) )
  
  dat_smoothed$under_pressure <- ifelse(dat_smoothed$under_pressure == "False", "FALSE", "True")
  dat_smoothed$shot_first_time <- ifelse(dat_smoothed$shot_first_time == "False", "FALSE", "True")
  
  dat_smoothed[,c("play_pattern", "shot_body_part","shot_first_time","shot_technique","shot_type","under_pressure", "home", "goal_YN")] <- dat_smoothed[,c("play_pattern", "shot_body_part","shot_first_time","shot_technique","shot_type","under_pressure", "home", "goal_YN")] %>% mutate_all(as.factor)
  
  save(dat_smoothed, file=paste0("../Dataset_ausiliari/", gsub(".csv", ".Rdata", csv_files[i])))
}
```
